title: The Second Warehouse

scenes.setup: 你入職第一天就收到新倉庫的租約。
scenes.text: The landlord will hold a $2,000 ____ until the lease ends. We'll get the full amount back if we return the space in good condition.

rescue.reaction: Think of money the landlord holds until we hand back the keys.

scenes.setup: 陳經理來電交代倉庫租購的決定。
scenes.text: The bank sent us a mortgage quote for buying the smaller warehouse, but the seller won't wait past noon. Can you tell Linda we're going ahead with the lease?
scenes.question: 陳經理要你轉告 Linda 什麼？
options: 公司要請賣方延長期限

rescue.reaction: We need somewhere to store the spring stock, and the rental unit is still available today.

scenes.setup: Linda 請你補完租倉庫的成本比較表。
scenes.text: The short-term loan rate is 5 percent per year. Show the ____ separately from the amount we borrow.

rescue.reaction: I need to see the cost of borrowing the money at that rate.

scenes.setup: 銀行來電追問原先申請的短期貸款。
scenes.text: The short-term loan is ready if you'd like it. I can hold the offer until Friday, so please call me by then if you decide to take it.
scenes.question: 銀行請你在什麼情況下回電？

rescue.reaction: There's nothing to repay yet because the money hasn't been sent.

scenes.setup: Linda 確認公司帳戶的餘額足夠。
scenes.text: Please record the $2,000 cash ____ on today's bank log. We need a record of the cash the bank hands us before we pay the landlord.

rescue.reaction: We're taking bills out of the account and carrying them to the signing.

scenes.setup: Ben 到分行後打電話請你幫忙。
scenes.text: The teller has the cash ready, but she needs to see the signed form. Could you bring it down to the bank?
scenes.question: Ben 請你帶什麼去銀行？

rescue.reaction: The cash is already here, and the woman at the counter is waiting for our paperwork.

ending: 你替租約備妥訂金，Linda 把原本夾在文件裡的購屋試算表抽了出來。

title: One Payment Too Many

scenes.setup: Linda 在登錄貨架款項時看到兩筆相同的金額。
scenes.text: I see a $600 debit on the account for the shelving. Before we send anything else, could you find out if that was yesterday's scheduled payment?
scenes.question: Linda 想先確認什麼？
options: 這筆扣款是否為昨天預定的付款
scenes.answer: 這筆扣款是否為昨天預定的付款

rescue.reaction: The money has left our account, and I want to know if it matches the payment we expected.
options: 這筆扣款是否為昨天預定的付款
rescue.answer: 這筆扣款是否為昨天預定的付款

scenes.setup: 你找到付款排程後，Linda 請你把銀行紀錄附上。
scenes.text: Please attach the May bank ____ showing every amount paid into and out of the account that month.

rescue.reaction: Use the bank's monthly record of what actually went through.

scenes.setup: Ben 找出公司訂購貨架時談好的付款條件。
scenes.text: The price is split into three equal payments. The second ____ is due on June 15.

rescue.reaction: We're paying the same amount again, one part of the total at a time.

scenes.setup: 貨架供應商打來問另一封付款通知是怎麼回事。
scenes.text: We received your scheduled payment this morning, so there's no need to wire us another $600. Could you remove that extra payment from your list?
scenes.question: 供應商請你怎麼處理另一筆款項？

rescue.reaction: We've received everything due this month, and a second transfer would pay us twice.

scenes.setup: 銀行回覆你稍早查詢的餘額警示。
scenes.text: That extra payment hasn't gone out, so it hasn't caused an overdraft. Your balance is still forty dollars above zero.
scenes.question: 目前帳戶餘額是多少？

rescue.reaction: There are still forty dollars available in the account.

scenes.setup: Linda 收到銀行退回上個月手續費的通知。
scenes.text: The bank returned last month's $15 service charge. Expect a $15 ____ to appear in the account tomorrow.

rescue.reaction: Tomorrow's entry will put the money back into the account.

ending: 你把重複扣款的提醒撤掉，並替下一期付款設好行事曆提醒。

title: A Van for Two Stops

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你替公司要添購的取貨廂型車找貸款。
scenes.text: Please ask each ____ for the annual rate and the total cost of borrowing $18,000.

rescue.reaction: We need quotes from the institutions that would give us the money up front.

scenes.setup: 分行承辦人來電確認申請表上的公司名稱。
scenes.text: The borrower will be Harbor & Pine Trading, correct? Please put the company name in that box instead of the driver's name.
scenes.question: 哪個名稱應該填在承辦人指定的欄位？

rescue.reaction: We're lending the money to the business, even if one employee drives the van.

scenes.setup: Ben 剛看完貸款條件，想確認要交哪份資料。
scenes.text: The bank will accept the van itself as collateral. Can you send them the dealer's description of the van?
scenes.question: Ben 請你寄給銀行什麼資料？

rescue.reaction: The bank needs details about the vehicle that will secure the loan.

scenes.setup: Linda 請你把銀行的報價分項登錄。
scenes.text: Record the one-time application ____ of $75 separately from the monthly payments. It covers the bank's work on the paperwork.

rescue.reaction: That charge is for processing the application.

scenes.setup: Linda 打來交代每月該從哪個帳戶扣款。
scenes.text: Use our checking account for the monthly payment. It's the account we already use to pay suppliers.
scenes.question: Linda 要從哪個帳戶扣車貸？
options: 替公司留存預備金的帳戶
專門收客戶訂金的帳戶
平常付供應商貨款的帳戶
scenes.answer: 平常付供應商貨款的帳戶

rescue.reaction: The same account handles our regular bills.
options: 平常付供應商貨款的帳戶
替公司留存預備金的帳戶
rescue.answer: 平常付供應商貨款的帳戶

scenes.setup: 送件前，Linda 補了一封信交代預備金的用途。
scenes.text: Leave the money in our ____ account untouched. We set it aside to earn interest and cover emergencies.

rescue.reaction: This is the account where we keep our reserve, away from everyday spending.

ending: 分行寄來補齊資料的貸款申請回條，Ben 把兩個取貨點圈在地圖上。

title: A Label Printer by Friday

scenes.setup: 陳經理打來談隔壁工坊出售的二手設備。
scenes.text: Our strategy is to buy only the equipment we can use this month. Could you check whether the seller will split the printers and the spare parts into separate lots?
scenes.question: 陳經理請你向賣方確認什麼？
options: 備用零件能否延長保固
印表機和備用零件能否分開賣
整批設備能否提早到貨
scenes.answer: 印表機和備用零件能否分開賣

rescue.reaction: We may want just one item, so I need to know whether we can buy it on its own.
options: 整批設備能否提早到貨
印表機和備用零件能否分開賣
rescue.answer: 印表機和備用零件能否分開賣

scenes.setup: Ben 翻到其中一台印表機的照片。
scenes.text: We should ____ the label printer for our packing desk. Our old one jammed twice this morning, and the seller is offering this one at half the price of a new unit.

rescue.reaction: We'd be buying the seller's machine to replace ours.

scenes.setup: 陳經理看完賣方開的價，打電話交代底線。
scenes.text: You can negotiate the price of the printer, but don't go above six hundred dollars. We can collect it ourselves if that helps.
scenes.question: 陳經理同意你怎麼談這筆買賣？
options: 接受含運費的七百元報價
改買整批設備以取得折扣
把價格談到六百元以內
scenes.answer: 把價格談到六百元以內

rescue.reaction: Six hundred is the most we can pay for the printer.
options: 把價格談到六百元以內
改買整批設備以取得折扣
rescue.answer: 把價格談到六百元以內

scenes.setup: 賣方接受價格後，Linda 請你走公司付款流程。
scenes.text: Please ask Ms. Chen to ____ the payment in our banking portal. Finance can release the funds once she's given permission.

rescue.reaction: We need her approval before the money can go out.

scenes.setup: 銀行還要核對紙本簽名才能放行匯款，承辦人打來約時間。
scenes.text: Your original signature card is in the vault, and I've asked a colleague to bring it up. Could you come to the branch after two instead of at noon?
scenes.question: 銀行建議你幾點去分行？

rescue.reaction: We need time to get the signature record out of secure storage.

scenes.setup: 你從銀行回來時，賣方寄信確認款項。
scenes.text: Your ____ of $580 arrived this afternoon. The printer is paid for in full and ready for pickup.

rescue.reaction: The funds have reached us, and there's nothing left to pay.

ending: 賣方同意分開販售設備，你把標籤機的取貨單交給 Ben。

title: Space on the Shelf

scenes.setup: 陳經理把 Ortiz 女士的新門市圖寄給你。
scenes.text: Ms. Ortiz is opening two more shops as part of her company's ____. Please find out how much shelf space she can give us.

rescue.reaction: Her current shops will stay open while the new locations are added.

scenes.setup: Ortiz 女士看到你寄來的門市名單後打來更正。
scenes.text: After our merger with North Market, both chains will share one buying office. For now, please send the offer directly to me.
scenes.question: 試賣提案目前應該寄給誰？

rescue.reaction: I'll handle this order myself while the two businesses are joining.

scenes.setup: Linda 發現 Ortiz 女士旗下的門市用另一個名稱請款。
scenes.text: Bill Market Home, a wholly owned ____ of our client's company. It is a separate business even though the parent company owns it.

rescue.reaction: The parent owns this entire business, and it has its own billing records.

scenes.setup: Linda 核對試賣試算表時停在第一欄。
scenes.text: Your revenue figure looks low because you've already taken out the shipping cost. Could you put total sales on that line?
scenes.question: Linda 要你在這一欄填什麼？

rescue.reaction: Use the amount customers pay before we subtract any expenses.

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你把試賣條件留在客戶往來紀錄裡。
scenes.text: Ms. Ortiz is our ____ on this deal. Her company buys goods from us and sells them in its own stores.

rescue.reaction: Her company is the one placing orders with Harbor & Pine.

scenes.setup: 下午接近下班時，Ortiz 女士打來縮小合作範圍。
scenes.text: I'd like to start this partnership with one shop before we include the others. Can you send me a short list of items to try there?
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望怎麼開始合作？
options: 等全數門市備貨後一起開賣

rescue.reaction: Let's find out what sells at a single location first.

ending: 你寄出第一間門市的試賣清單，Ortiz 女士回信訂下下週的樣品時段。

title: A Desk Near the Port

scenes.setup: Ben 邊量港邊辦公室的桌子邊打給你。
scenes.text: This branch has room for two desks, but I only found one power outlet. Could you add a second outlet to the setup list?
scenes.question: Ben 發現港邊辦公室缺什麼？

rescue.reaction: Both desks will fit here, but they'll need somewhere to plug in their equipment.

scenes.setup: 陳經理看到草稿列了不少裝修細節。
scenes.text: The main ____ of the port office is to cut the time drivers spend collecting paperwork. Please put that goal on the first page.

rescue.reaction: Start with what we hope to achieve by opening the office.

scenes.setup: Ben 在港邊跟司機聊過後再打給你。
scenes.text: A competitor already lets drivers pick up paperwork in the evening. Do you think we could stay open until seven twice a week?
scenes.question: Ben 建議試辦哪種服務？
options: 每天提早到早上七點開門
每週增加兩個白天取件時段
每週兩天延長營業到晚上七點
scenes.answer: 每週兩天延長營業到晚上七點

rescue.reaction: I was thinking about drivers who finish their routes after regular office hours.
options: 每週兩天延長營業到晚上七點
每天提早到早上七點開門
rescue.answer: 每週兩天延長營業到晚上七點

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你先聽聽每天會用到辦公點的人怎麼說。
scenes.text: Anyone affected by the new pickup hours is a ____ and should have a chance to comment. Please invite a driver and a warehouse clerk.

rescue.reaction: We want input from the people whose work will change.

scenes.setup: Linda 來電說明試辦申請要送去哪裡。
scenes.text: Headquarters will review the plan next week. Send a copy to the operations director there along with the cost sheet.
scenes.question: Linda 請你把成本表交給誰？
options: 港邊辦公點的值班人員

rescue.reaction: The decision will be made at the main office, where the operations director works.

scenes.setup: 收齊意見後，陳經理請你整理送審版本。
scenes.text: Please send the final ____ this afternoon. It should describe the trial hours, expected costs, and what we need management to approve.

rescue.reaction: We're asking management to approve a plan for work that hasn't started.

ending: 你送出港邊辦公點的試辦提案，把司機臨停的位置也標在附件裡。

title: The Saturday Desk

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你加入週六取貨服務的試辦。
scenes.text: For our Saturday pickup ____, we're setting up a desk and trying it for two weeks. Please ask the warehouse team how many orders they can prepare.

rescue.reaction: This is a new effort to offer a service we haven't tried before.

scenes.setup: Ben 在倉庫門口打來告訴你現場限制。
scenes.text: We can operate the pickup desk until noon on Saturdays, when the warehouse closes. Would that be enough time for Ms. Ortiz's drivers?
scenes.question: Ben 想確認什麼？
options: 倉庫週日是否會提早開門
週六中午前取貨的安排是否可行
司機週五能否先送貨到倉庫
scenes.answer: 週六中午前取貨的安排是否可行

rescue.reaction: We can serve her drivers that morning, up until closing time.
options: 週六中午前取貨的安排是否可行
倉庫週日是否會提早開門
rescue.answer: 週六中午前取貨的安排是否可行

scenes.setup: 你詢問司機的班表後，Ortiz 女士打來回覆。
scenes.text: We can manage a morning pickup, but our driver has another stop at ten. Could you have our boxes ready by nine?
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望最晚幾點備妥貨物？

rescue.reaction: Our driver needs to collect the boxes before heading to the ten o'clock stop.

scenes.setup: Ben 請你把取貨規定放進通知信。
scenes.text: Our pickup ____ requires drivers to show photo ID before we hand over any goods. That rule applies on Saturdays as well.

rescue.reaction: It's a rule every driver needs to follow, regardless of the day.

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你準備下午試辦會議要用的資料。
scenes.text: Please prepare a five-minute ____ for the meeting. Bring two slides and talk us through the proposed opening hours.

rescue.reaction: We need you to speak to the group, with a couple of slides to refer to.

scenes.setup: 陳經理在會後打來說明誰會看試辦成果。
scenes.text: An executive from the operations team approved the trial. She wants to see how many orders are picked up on the first Saturday.
scenes.question: 營運主管想知道試辦首日的哪項數字？

rescue.reaction: Count the orders that actually leave the pickup desk that day.

ending: 陳經理核准週六試辦，你把值班表上的空格留給下午才回覆的同事。

title: The Lamp at the Counter

scenes.setup: Ben 在展示間櫃台接到一通報修電話。
scenes.text: A customer just called about a desk lamp that won't turn on. Could you find the record of her purchase before she comes in?
scenes.question: Ben 請你在顧客到店前查什麼？

rescue.reaction: She bought the lamp here, so we need to see when and how she paid.

scenes.setup: Ben 把原本夾在保固卡裡的文件掃描給你。
scenes.text: I've attached the ____ from our register. It shows that the customer paid $42 by card on June 3.

rescue.reaction: The card payment has already gone through, and this is her proof of purchase.

scenes.setup: 你把檯燈序號寄給供應商查詢。
scenes.text: The lamp is still under ____. We cover faults reported within one year of purchase, so you may return this unit to us at no charge.

rescue.reaction: Our promise to cover manufacturing faults is still in effect.

scenes.setup: 陳經理打來交代同批檯燈的處理方式。
scenes.text: Move the remaining merchandise from that batch off the sales floor until Ben can test it. There's space for the boxes by the repair counter.
scenes.question: 陳經理要你把剩下的檯燈搬去哪裡？

rescue.reaction: Keep the boxed stock away from shoppers while we check the lamps.

scenes.setup: Ben 和顧客談過後，打來請你改櫃台紀錄。
scenes.text: I offered her a discount on a different model, but she'd like her money back. Could you mark the return as a refund?
scenes.question: 顧客選擇哪種處理方式？
options: 以折扣價購買另一款檯燈

rescue.reaction: She'd rather leave without a lamp and get back what she paid.
options: 以折扣價購買另一款檯燈

scenes.setup: 你登錄退貨後，Linda 寄信說明入帳方式。
scenes.text: Please issue a ____ of $42 to the card she paid with. We've received the returned lamp, and the sale will be reversed.

rescue.reaction: Put the purchase price back on her card as a reversal of the sale.

ending: 顧客拿到故障檯燈的退款，Ben 把其餘同批商品移到待檢區。

title: Bowls Before Opening

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你接手 Ortiz 女士門市的補貨單。
scenes.text: Ms. Ortiz is the ____ for these ceramic bowls. Her shops sell them one at a time to people who need dishes for their homes.

rescue.reaction: Her shops sell directly to the people who will use the bowls.

scenes.setup: Ben 到倉庫清點後打給你。
scenes.text: We have one case of blue bowls in stock and three cases of white ones. Can you ask Ms. Ortiz whether she needs more than a case of blue?
scenes.question: 倉庫目前有幾箱藍碗？

rescue.reaction: There are plenty of white bowls, but only one sealed case in blue.

scenes.setup: Linda 發現你從門市網站抄了價格。
scenes.text: Use the ____ price of $4 per bowl for the case Ms. Ortiz will resell. Her shoppers will pay the $8 retail price.

rescue.reaction: Use the rate we charge a store buying in bulk for resale.

scenes.setup: Ortiz 女士試著在線上下單，不過畫面顯示了單個售價。
scenes.text: At checkout the website charged me for a single bowl. Could you send me a link that lets me pay for the whole case?
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望收到哪種連結？
options: 能查詢單個售價的連結
能預約門市取貨的連結
能支付整箱貨款的連結
scenes.answer: 能支付整箱貨款的連結

rescue.reaction: I'm ready to pay, and I need the link for the box of twelve.
options: 能支付整箱貨款的連結
能預約門市取貨的連結
rescue.answer: 能支付整箱貨款的連結

scenes.setup: 你確認整箱價格後，Ortiz 女士回信同意付款。
scenes.text: We'll ____ one case of blue bowls at the agreed price. Please send the payment link so we can buy it today.

rescue.reaction: I have approval to pay for the case today.

scenes.setup: 付款完成後，Ben 從倉庫打來確認出貨標籤。
scenes.text: The order is ready to go, and I've put it by the loading door. What address should I write on the shipping label?
scenes.question: Ben 還需要知道什麼？

rescue.reaction: I have the box and the label here, but I need to know where the box is going.

ending: 你替 Ortiz 女士保留了最後一箱藍碗，在開店前把確認單寄到她手上。

title: The Green Lunch Bag

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你替展示間的週末特賣挑商品。
scenes.text: For this weekend's ____, we'll offer a lower price on insulated lunch bags and put them by the entrance. Please choose a sample for the display.

rescue.reaction: The temporary sale is meant to bring more shoppers into the showroom.

scenes.setup: Ben 找到供應商剛寄來的型錄。
scenes.text: The new catalog shows that the lunch bag comes in green now. Could you check whether our vendor can send us a green sample by Friday?
scenes.question: Ben 想請供應商在週五前做什麼？

rescue.reaction: I can see the new color in the brochure, and I'd like to see it in person before the sale.

scenes.setup: 陳經理請你為選中的保冷袋建立網頁。
scenes.text: Create a ____ page for the lunch bag. Include its size, color choices, and a photo of the item we're selling.

rescue.reaction: Give shoppers a single page with the details of the bag itself.

scenes.setup: Ben 從展示間打來說明誰能處理樣品出貨。
scenes.text: The vendor says the sales office has a green bag ready for us. Could you ask their shipping clerk to send it straight to the showroom?
scenes.question: Ben 請你找誰安排寄送？

rescue.reaction: The sample is with the company that sells us the bags, and their shipping staff can send it.

scenes.setup: Ben 把附近店家的售價貼在特賣草稿上。
scenes.text: At $12, this lunch bag is a ____ compared with similar bags that cost $25. Let's keep the price large enough to read from the entrance.

rescue.reaction: We're giving shoppers unusually good value for their money.

scenes.setup: 供應商發現第一個展示樣品寄錯顏色。
scenes.text: We can exchange the blue sample for a green one today. Please give the blue bag to the driver when she drops off the replacement.
scenes.question: 司機送來替換品時，你要把什麼交給她？

rescue.reaction: The driver will bring the color you wanted and take the original sample back.

ending: 供應商送來綠色樣品，你把它拍進週末特賣的網頁。

title: A Spoonful at the Market

scenes.setup: Ortiz 女士來電談週末市集的果醬攤。
scenes.text: Could we offer a sample of the peach jam to anyone who stops by? I'd like them to try a little before they buy a jar.
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望逛市集的人先做什麼？
